view.name: Battlefield – player's turn
view.description: Hex battlefield in round 8 with summoned creatures, the turn queue along the bottom, the active Swampler's ability buttons on the left, game controls on the right and the combat log.

regions.label: Dark textured decorative bar across the top
Painted desert battlefield with units on hex tiles, HP number pills and floating combat text
Active creature ability icon with vertical health/energy meters
Single-line timestamped combat log that expands on hover into scrollable history
Vertical icon buttons: music, fast forward, skip turn (stopwatch), fullscreen, with violet meter bar
Turn-order queue of creature portraits with status labels (Queued, Sickened, Protected, HP) and Round divider
Player1 stats panel: points, plasma, units

evidence.note: Collapsed log shows latest event; hover expands into a timestamped list of all match events (verified live; full list in a11y tree)
Status label under queue portrait; others: Sickened, Queued, 43/70
HP pill under each unit, team-colored outline
Hover on toolbar button shows tooltip to its left: 'hotkey F / Fast Forward / Click to return to normal replay speed.' (live only, not in capture)

patterns.rationale: Player panel lists several numbers (points, plasma, units) in one box rather than one key metric; could be read as a stat panel rather than a stat tile.
Tutorial hints appear as entries in the combat log (a11y tree) but not as help anchored to UI in the capture.

structure.layout: full-viewport game canvas: painted desert battlefield with hex-grid units, framed by dark textured top/bottom bars; bottom-left HUD with active unit portrait + turn-order queue strip; centered collapsible combat log; right-edge vertical icon toolbar and player info panel

aesthetics.typography: Play (sans, slightly squared techno face) for all HUD text: log, labels, player panel; floating combat text in yellow outlined Play
aesthetics.typeScale: Small HUD scale: 18px log/combat text, 14px queue labels and panel stats, 12px HP pills; little hierarchy beyond color

notes: Turn-based hex tactics game. Painted full-bleed desert backdrop; units are illustrated sprites with team-colored (red vs blue) HP pills and hex highlights. Bottom queue: square portraits with thick red/blue team borders and small colored status strips beneath (yellow Protected, olive Sickened, slate Queued). Floating yellow combat text with dark outline. Right toolbar uses brown leather-like square tiles with white glyphs. Log is a translucent rounded pill (20px radius) that expands on hover. Proposed new entry game-board-hud for the battlefield + initiative queue, which the codebook cannot express.
